notes:
Lead profile: SMB SaaS company building an in-app smart support assistant (ticket summarization + tool calls to internal ticket API). Self-serve signup on hosted API. Early discovery: want predictable structured JSON outputs from streaming mode so their client-side parser can immediate hydrate UI.

Problem summary: customer sees JSON parse failures when using streaming + function-calling / JSON-mode. Typical symptoms: partial JSON object chunks that when concatenated still sometimes include extra commas or newline artifacts; streaming sequence emits event chunk that their parser treats as an early terminator; some function-call responses not matching provided function schema keys (e.g., expected "ticket_id" but got "ticketID" or nested arrays). Node/Browser differences reported (Node v18 fetch stream OK sometimes; browser FetchEventSource fails more often). Error strings reported: "SyntaxError: Unexpected token , in JSON at position 0" and "Unterminated string in JSON at end of stream".

Customer repro (supplied):
- Using Redwood hosted API, "mode": "stream", response_format: "json", function_schema: {"name":"create_ticket","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"ticket_id":{"type":"string"},"summary":{"type":"string"}}}}
- Got streamed chunks: "{\"ticket_id\": \"TCK-123\", \"summary\": \"...\"}," then next chunk "\n{\"ticket_id\": \"TCK-124\"..." which produced an extra comma between objects.

What they've tried:
- Switched to non-streaming (single-shot) — works but too slow for UI.
- Added small debounce buffer client-side to concatenate chunks — reduces but doesn't eliminate errors.
- Downgraded SDK from v0.8.2 -> v0.8.0 (reported one call became stable) but not reliable.
- Attempted strict function schemas with required fields — model sometimes emits extra fields or different casing.

Customer quote (CTO): "We need deterministic JSON chunks or a reliable per-event wrapper so our parser never fails in users' browsers. If streaming is brittle we can't use hosted API for production."

Suggested Redwood next steps (from AE/SE notes):
- Ask customer to produce minimal reproducible example (Node browser + headers + exact request body) and attach raw streamed response (hex or raw text).
- Re-run in Redwood sandbox with logging enabled to capture low-level events (stream framing, chunk boundaries).
- Validate whether issue is model output (malformed JSON tokens emitted) vs transport (event source framing, event delimiter).
- Try toggles: explicit event framing (e.g., newline-delimited JSON: NDJSON), enable/disable streaming SSE wrapper, force function_call: explicit to ensure model uses schema strictly.
- If model emits non-conforming keys, propose a post-processing step at runtime (schema normalizer) or enforce function calling strictness server-side.
